cases.query: 2026-05各渠道激活率实际值与目标差距；请返回渠道名称、实际比率、激活率目标、目标差距；聚合口径：数量指标按对应业务记录计数，可加总指标按当前查询粒度求和，比率按汇总后的分子除以分母。

sql_metrics.generated_sql:
SELECT
  ac.channel_name,
  ROUND(
    (
      SUM(CASE WHEN ua.is_activated = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric /
      NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ur.registration_id), 0)
    )::numeric,
    4
  ) AS actual_activation_rate,
  gt.activation_rate_target,
  ROUND(
    (
      (
        SUM(CASE WHEN ua.is_activated = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric /
        NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ur.registration_id), 0)
      ) - gt.activation_rate_target
    )::numeric,
    4
  ) AS target_gap
FROM askdata_ops.user_registrations ur
JOIN askdata_ops.acquisition_channels ac ON ur.channel_id = ac.channel_id
LEFT JOIN askdata_ops.user_activations ua ON ur.registration_id = ua.registration_id
JOIN askdata_ops.growth_targets gt ON ac.channel_id = gt.channel_id
WHERE ur.registered_at >= '2026-05-01' AND ur.registered_at < '2026-06-01'
  AND gt.target_month = '2026-05'
GROUP BY ac.channel_name, gt.activation_rate_target
ORDER BY actual_activation_rate DESC, ac.channel_name ASC

result_metrics.reason: 结果一致（忽略列顺序和辅助列）
result_metrics.gold_sql:
WITH actual AS (
  SELECT
    r.channel_id,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.is_activated <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) AS actual_rate
  FROM user_registrations AS r
  JOIN user_activations AS a
    ON r.registration_id = a.registration_id
  WHERE
    TO_CHAR(r.registered_at, 'YYYY-MM') = '2026-05'
  GROUP BY
    1
)
SELECT
  c.channel_name,
  ROUND(CAST(a.actual_rate AS DECIMAL), 4) AS actual_rate,
  t.activation_rate_target,
  ROUND(CAST(a.actual_rate - t.activation_rate_target AS DECIMAL), 4) AS gap
FROM growth_targets AS t
JOIN acquisition_channels AS c
  ON t.channel_id = c.channel_id
JOIN actual AS a
  ON t.channel_id = a.channel_id
WHERE
  SUBSTRING(t.target_month FROM 1 FOR 7) = '2026-05'
ORDER BY
  gap DESC NULLS LAST,
  1
